units.rightText: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are round about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

units.leftText: And they will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries.
units.rightText: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall disperse them among the nations, and scatter them through the countries.

units.leftText: But I will spare a few of them from sword and famine and plague, so that in the nations to which they go, they can recount all their abominations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the nations whither they come; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, eat your bread with trembling, and drink your water with quivering and anxiety.
units.rightText: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with fearfulness;

units.leftText: Then tell the people of the land that this is what the Lord GOD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: ‘They will eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water in dread, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who dwell in it.
units.rightText: and say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with fearfulness, and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and despoiled of all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.

units.leftText: The inhabited cities will be laid waste, and the land will become desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’” The Presumptuous Proverb
units.rightText: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be a desolation; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by, and every vision fails’?
units.rightText: Son of man, what is this proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?

units.leftText: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will put an end to this proverb, and in Israel they will no longer recite it.’
units.rightText: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the fulfilment of every vision.

units.leftText: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations within the house of Israel,
units.rightText: For there shall be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

units.leftText: because I, the LORD, will speak whatever word I speak, and it will be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, O rebellious house, I will speak a message and bring it to pass, declares the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: For I am Jehovah; I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be performed; it shall be no more deferred: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I speak the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Furthermore, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, take note that the house of Israel is saying, ‘The vision that he sees is for many years from now; he prophesies about the distant future.’
units.rightText: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of times that are far off.

units.leftText: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘None of My words will be delayed any longer. The message I speak will be fulfilled, declares the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: There shall none of my words be deferred any more, but the word which I shall speak shall be performed, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Tell those who prophesy out of their own imagination: Hear the word of the LORD!
units.rightText: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own heart, Hear ye the word of Jehovah:

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit yet have seen nothing.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

units.leftText: Your prophets, O Israel, are like foxes among the ruins.
units.rightText: O Israel, thy prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

units.leftText: You did not go up to the gaps or restore the wall around the house of Israel so that it would stand in the battle on the Day of the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the day of Jehovah.

units.leftText: They see false visions and speak lying divinations. They claim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ when the LORD did not send them; yet they wait for the fulfillment of their message.
units.rightText: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, that say, Jehovah saith; but Jehovah hath not sent them: and they have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

units.leftText: Haven’t you seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you proclaim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ even though I have not spoken?
units.rightText: Have ye not seen a false vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, in that ye say, Jehovah saith; albeit I have not spoken?

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have uttered vain words and seen false visions, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have spoken falsehood, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and speak lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of My people or be recorded in the register of the house of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: And my hand shall be against the prophets that see false visions, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the council of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Because they have led My people astray, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and whitewashing any flimsy wall that is built,
units.rightText: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there is no peace; and when one buildeth up a wall, behold, they daub it with untempered mortar:

units.leftText: tell those whitewashing the wall that it will fall. Rain will come in torrents, I will send hailstones plunging down, and a windstorm will burst forth.
units.rightText: say unto them that daub it with untempered mortar, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.

units.leftText: Surely when the wall has fallen, you will not be asked, ‘Where is the whitewash with which you covered it?’
units.rightText: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In My wrath I will release a windstorm, and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my wrath; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

units.leftText: I will tear down the wall you whitewashed and level it to the ground, so that its foundation is exposed. The city will fall, and you will be destroyed within it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered mortar, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be uncovered; and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: And after I have vented My wrath against the wall and against those who whitewashed it, I will say to you: ‘The wall is gone, and so are those who whitewashed it —
units.rightText: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered mortar; and I will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;

units.leftText: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw a vision of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Lord GOD.’ Reproof of False Prophetesses
units.rightText: to wit, the prophets of Israel that prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and that see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Now, O son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, that prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

units.leftText: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on their wrists and make veils for the heads of people of every height, in order to ensnare their souls. Will you ensnare the souls of My people but preserve your own?
units.rightText: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the women that sew pillows upon all elbows, and make kerchiefs for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and save souls alive for yourselves?

units.leftText: You have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to My people who would listen, you have killed those who should not have died and spared those who should not have lived.
units.rightText: And ye have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hearken unto lies.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: See, I am against the magic charms with which you ensnare souls like birds, and I will tear them from your arms. So I will free the souls you have ensnared like birds.
units.rightText: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms; and I will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.

units.leftText: I will also tear off your veils and deliver My people from your hands, so that they will no longer be prey in your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Because you have disheartened the righteous with your lies, even though I have caused them no grief, and because you have encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways to save their lives,
units.rightText: Because with lies ye have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad, and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive;

units.leftText: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will deliver My people from your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: Therefore ye shall no more see false visions, nor divine divinations: and I will deliver my people out of your hand; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then some of the elders of Israel came and sat down before me.
units.rightText: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.

units.leftText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I consult with them in any way?
units.rightText: Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be inquired of at all by them?

units.leftText: Therefore speak to them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry,
units.rightText: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Every man of the house of Israel that taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I Jehovah will answer him therein according to the multitude of his idols;

units.leftText: so that I may take hold of the hearts of the people of Israel. For because of their idols, they are all estranged from Me.’
units.rightText: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

units.leftText: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Repent and turn away from your idols; turn your faces away from all your abominations.
units.rightText: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Return ye, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

units.leftText: For when any Israelite or any foreigner dwelling in Israel separates himself from Me, sets up idols in his heart, and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet to inquire of Me, I the LORD will answer him Myself.
units.rightText: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that separateth himself from me, and taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet to inquire for himself of me; I Jehovah will answer him by myself:

units.leftText: I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a proverb; I will cut him off from among My people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: and I will set my face against that man, and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: But if the prophet is enticed to speak a message, then it was I the LORD who enticed him, and I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel.
units.rightText: And if the prophet be deceived and speak a word, I, Jehovah, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

units.leftText: They will bear their punishment— the punishment of the inquirer will be the same as that of the prophet—
units.rightText: And they shall bear their iniquity: the iniquity of the prophet shall be even as the iniquity of him that seeketh unto him;

units.leftText: in order that the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me and no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions. Then they will be My people and I will be their God, declares the Lord GOD.’” Four Dire Judgments
units.rightText: that the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, if a land sins against Me by acting unfaithfully, and I stretch out My hand against it to cut off its supply of food, to send famine upon it, and to cut off from it both man and beast,
units.rightText: Son of man, when a land sinneth against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand upon it, and break the staff of the bread thereof, and send famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast;
leftNotes: 14:13 Hebrew staff

units.leftText: then even if these three men— Noah, Daniel, and Job— were in it, their righteousness could deliver only themselves, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Or if I send wild beasts through the land to leave it childless and desolate, with no man passing through it for fear of the beasts,
units.rightText: If I cause evil beasts to pass through the land, and they ravage it, and it be made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the beasts;

units.leftText: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if these three men were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. They alone would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.
units.rightText: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only should be delivered, but the land should be desolate.

units.leftText: Or if I bring a sword against that land and say, ‘Let a sword pass through it,’ so that I cut off from it both man and beast,
units.rightText: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off from it man and beast;

units.leftText: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if these three men were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. They alone would be delivered.
units.rightText: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only should be delivered themselves.

units.leftText: Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out My wrath upon it through bloodshed, cutting off from it both man and beast,
units.rightText: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast;

units.leftText: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. Their righteousness could deliver only themselves.
units.rightText: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither son nor daughter; they should but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem My four dire judgments— sword, famine, wild beasts, and plague— in order to cut off from it both man and beast?
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the evil beasts, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast!

units.leftText: Yet , behold, some survivors will be left in it — sons and daughters who will be brought out. They will come out to you, and when you see their conduct and actions, you will be comforted regarding the disaster I have brought upon Jerusalem — all that I have brought upon it.
units.rightText: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be carried forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings; and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.

units.leftText: They will bring you consolation when you see their conduct and actions, and you will know that it was not without cause that I have done all these things within it,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their way and their doings; and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, how does the wood of the vine surpass any other branch among the trees in the forest?
units.rightText: Son of man, what is the vine-tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?

units.leftText: Can wood be taken from it to make something useful? Or can one make from it a peg on which to hang utensils?
units.rightText: Shall wood be taken thereof to make any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?

units.leftText: No, it is cast into the fire for fuel. The fire devours both ends, and the middle is charred. Can it be useful for anything?
units.rightText: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire hath devoured both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned: is it profitable for any work?

units.leftText: Even when it was whole, it could not be made useful. How much less can it ever be useful when the fire has consumed it and charred it!
units.rightText: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned, shall it yet be meet for any work!

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give up the people of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As the vine-tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: And I will set My face against them. Though they may have escaped the fire, yet another fire will consume them. And when I set My face against them, you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: And I will set my face against them; they shall go forth from the fire, but the fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I set my face against them.

units.leftText: Thus I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her abominations
units.rightText: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

units.leftText: and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: Your origin and your birth were in the land of the Canaanites. Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
units.rightText: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto Jerusalem: Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of the Canaanite; the Amorite was thy father, and thy mother was a Hittite.

units.leftText: On the day of your birth your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water for cleansing. You were not rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.
units.rightText: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to cleanse thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

units.leftText: No one cared enough for you to do even one of these things out of compassion for you. Instead, you were thrown out into the open field, because you were despised on the day of your birth.
units.rightText: No eye pitied thee, to do any of these things unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, for that thy person was abhorred, in the day that thou wast born.

units.leftText: Then I passed by and saw you wallowing in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, ‘Live!’ There I said to you, ‘Live!’
units.rightText: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee weltering in thy blood, I said unto thee, Though thou art in thy blood, live; yea, I said unto thee, Though thou art in thy blood, live.

units.leftText: I made you thrive like a plant of the field. You grew up and matured and became very beautiful. Your breasts were formed and your hair grew, but you were naked and bare.
units.rightText: I caused thee to multiply as that which groweth in the field, and thou didst increase and wax great, and thou attainedst to excellent ornament; thy breasts were fashioned, and thy hair was grown; yet thou wast naked and bare.

units.leftText: Then I passed by and saw you, and you were indeed old enough for love. So I spread My cloak over you and covered your nakedness. I pledged Myself to you, entered into a covenant with you, and you became Mine, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord Jehovah, and thou becamest mine.

units.leftText: Then I bathed you with water, rinsed off your blood, and anointed you with oil.
units.rightText: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

units.leftText: I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of fine leather. I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk.
units.rightText: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with sealskin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and covered thee with silk.

units.leftText: I adorned you with jewelry, and I put bracelets on your wrists and a chain around your neck.
units.rightText: And I decked thee with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

units.leftText: I put a ring in your nose, earrings on your ears, and a beautiful crown upon your head.
units.rightText: And I put a ring upon thy nose, and ear-rings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thy head.

units.leftText: So you were adorned with gold and silver, and your clothing was made of fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You became very beautiful and rose to be queen.
units.rightText: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil; and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper unto royal estate.

units.leftText: Your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, for it was perfect in the splendor I bestowed on you, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: And thy renown went forth among the nations for thy beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: But because of your fame, you trusted in your beauty and played the harlot. You lavished your favors on everyone who passed by, and your beauty was theirs for the asking.
units.rightText: But thou didst trust in thy beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy whoredoms on every one that passed by; his it was.

units.leftText: You took some of your garments and made colorful high places for yourself, and on them you prostituted yourself. Such things should not have happened; never should they have occurred!
units.rightText: And thou didst take of thy garments, and madest for thee high places decked with divers colors, and playedst the harlot upon them: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.

units.leftText: You also took the fine jewelry of gold and silver I had given you, and you made male idols with which to prostitute yourself.
units.rightText: Thou didst also take thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest for thee images of men, and didst play the harlot with them;

units.leftText: You took your embroidered garments to cover them, and you set My oil and incense before them.
units.rightText: and thou tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them, and didst set mine oil and mine incense before them.

units.leftText: And you set before them as a pleasing aroma the food I had given you— the fine flour, oil, and honey that I had fed you. That is what happened, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: My bread also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou didst even set it before them for a sweet savor; and thus it was, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: You even took the sons and daughters you bore to Me and sacrificed them as food to idols. Was your prostitution not enough?
units.rightText: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Were thy whoredoms a small matter,

units.leftText: You slaughtered My children and delivered them up through the fire to idols.
units.rightText: that thou hast slain my children, and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire unto them?

units.leftText: And in all your abominations and acts of prostitution, you did not remember the days of your youth when you were naked and bare, wallowing in your own blood.
units.rightText: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast weltering in thy blood.

units.leftText: Woe! Woe to you, declares the Lord GOD. And in addition to all your other wickedness,
units.rightText: And it is come to pass after all thy wickedness (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord Jehovah),

units.leftText: you built yourself a mound and made yourself a lofty shrine in every public square.
units.rightText: that thou hast built unto thee a vaulted place, and hast made thee a lofty place in every street.

units.leftText: At the head of every street you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty. With increasing promiscuity, you spread your legs to all who passed by.
units.rightText: Thou hast built thy lofty place at the head of every way, and hast made thy beauty an abomination, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredom.

units.leftText: You prostituted yourself with your lustful neighbors, the Egyptians, and increased your promiscuity to provoke Me to anger.
units.rightText: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians, thy neighbors, great of flesh; and hast multiplied thy whoredom, to provoke me to anger.

units.leftText: Therefore I stretched out My hand against you and reduced your portion. I gave you over to the desire of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd conduct.
units.rightText: Behold therefore, I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, that are ashamed of thy lewd way.

units.leftText: Then you prostituted yourself with the Assyrians, because you were not yet satisfied. Even after that, you were still not satisfied.
units.rightText: Thou hast played the harlot also with the Assyrians, because thou wast insatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet thou wast not satisfied.

units.leftText: So you extended your promiscuity to Chaldea, the land of merchants — but even with this you were not satisfied!
units.rightText: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy whoredom unto the land of traffic, unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
leftNotes: 16:29 Or Babylonia

units.leftText: How weak-willed is your heart, declares the Lord GOD, while you do all these things, the acts of a shameless prostitute!
units.rightText: How weak is thy heart, saith the Lord Jehovah, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an impudent harlot;
leftNotes: 16:30 Or How feverish is your heart,

units.leftText: But when you built your mounds at the head of every street and made your lofty shrines in every public square, you were not even like a prostitute, because you scorned payment.
units.rightText: in that thou buildest thy vaulted place at the head of every way, and makest thy lofty place in every street, and hast not been as a harlot, in that thou scornest hire.

units.leftText: You adulterous wife! You receive strangers instead of your own husband!
units.rightText: A wife that committeth adultery! that taketh strangers instead of her husband!

units.leftText: Men give gifts to all their prostitutes, but you gave gifts to all your lovers. You bribed them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors.
units.rightText: They give gifts to all harlots; but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and bribest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredoms.

units.leftText: So your prostitution is the opposite of that of other women: No one solicited your favors, and you paid a fee instead of receiving one; so you are the very opposite! Judgment on Jerusalem
units.rightText: And thou art different from other women in thy whoredoms, in that none followeth thee to play the harlot; and whereas thou givest hire, and no hire is given unto thee, therefore thou art different.

units.leftText: Therefore, O prostitute, hear the word of the LORD!
units.rightText: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of Jehovah:

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you poured out your wealth and exposed your nakedness in your promiscuity with your lovers and with all your detestable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them,
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness uncovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers; and because of all the idols of thy abominations, and for the blood of thy children, that thou didst give unto them;

units.leftText: therefore I will surely gather all the lovers with whom you found pleasure, all those you loved and all those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and expose you before them, and they will see you completely naked.
units.rightText: therefore behold, I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them against thee on every side, and will uncover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

units.leftText: And I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and those who shed blood; so I will bring upon you the wrath of your bloodshed and jealousy.
units.rightText: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring upon thee the blood of wrath and jealousy.

units.leftText: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will level your mounds and tear down your lofty shrines. They will strip off your clothes, take your fine jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
units.rightText: I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thy vaulted place, and break down thy lofty places; and they shall strip thee of thy clothes, and take thy fair jewels; and they shall leave thee naked and bare.

units.leftText: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and cut you to pieces with their swords.
units.rightText: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

units.leftText: Then they will burn down your houses and execute judgment against you in the sight of many women.
units.rightText: And they shall burn thy houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women; and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou shalt also give no hire any more.

units.leftText: So I will lay to rest My wrath against you, and My jealousy will turn away from you. Then I will be calm and no longer angry.
units.rightText: So will I cause my wrath toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

units.leftText: Because you did not remember the days of your youth, but enraged Me with all these things, I will surely bring your deeds down upon your own head, declares the Lord GOD. Have you not committed this lewdness on top of all your other abominations?
units.rightText: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring thy way upon thy head, saith the Lord Jehovah: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness with all thine abominations.

units.leftText: Behold, all who speak in proverbs will quote this proverb about you: ‘Like mother, like daughter.’
units.rightText: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.

units.leftText: You are the daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and children. You are the sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
units.rightText: Thou art the daughter of thy mother, that loatheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children: your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

units.leftText: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived with her daughters to your north; and your younger sister was Sodom, who lived with her daughters to your south.
units.rightText: And thine elder sister is Samaria, that dwelleth at thy left hand, she and her daughters; and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

units.leftText: And you not only walked in their ways and practiced their abominations, but soon you were more depraved than they were.
units.rightText: Yet hast thou not walked in their ways, nor done after their abominations; but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast more corrupt than they in all thy ways.

units.leftText: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, your sister Sodom and her daughters never did as you and your daughters have done.
units.rightText: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

units.leftText: Now this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed, and complacent; they did not help the poor and needy.
units.rightText: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom: pride, fulness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

units.leftText: Thus they were haughty and committed abominations before Me. Therefore I removed them, as you have seen.
units.rightText: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
leftNotes: 16:50 A few Hebrew manuscripts and LXX; MT as I have seen

units.leftText: Furthermore, Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have multiplied your abominations beyond theirs, and all the abominations you have committed have made your sisters appear righteous.
units.rightText: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters by all thine abominations which thou hast done.

units.leftText: So now you must bear your disgrace, since you have brought justification for your sisters. For they appear more righteous than you, because your sins were more vile than theirs. So you too must bear your shame and disgrace, since you have made your sisters appear righteous.
units.rightText: Thou also, bear thou thine own shame, in that thou hast given judgment for thy sisters; through thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou also confounded, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

units.leftText: But I will restore Sodom and her daughters from captivity, as well as Samaria and her daughters. And I will restore you along with them.
units.rightText: And I will turn again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them;
leftNotes: 16:53 Or restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters

units.leftText: So you will bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you did to comfort them.
units.rightText: that thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be ashamed because of all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

units.leftText: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to their former state. You and your daughters will also return to your former state.
units.rightText: And thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate; and thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.

units.leftText: Did you not treat your sister Sodom as an object of scorn in the day of your pride,
units.rightText: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

units.leftText: before your wickedness was uncovered? Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all those around her, and by the daughters of the Philistines— all those around you who despise you.
units.rightText: before thy wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, that do despite unto thee round about.
leftNotes: 16:57 Many Hebrew manuscripts and Syriac; most Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Vulgate Aram

units.leftText: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your abominations, declares the LORD. The Covenant Remembered
units.rightText: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with you according to your deeds, since you have despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also deal with thee as thou hast done, who hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

units.leftText: But I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
units.rightText: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

units.leftText: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your older and younger sisters. I will give them to you as daughters, but not because of My covenant with you.
units.rightText: Then shalt thou remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder sisters and thy younger; and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

units.leftText: So I will establish My covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD,
units.rightText: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah;

units.leftText: so that when I make atonement for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your disgrace, declares the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: that thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more, because of thy shame, when I have forgiven thee all that thou hast done, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, pose a riddle; speak a parable to the house of Israel
units.rightText: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;

units.leftText: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘A great eagle with great wings and long pinions, full of feathers of many colors, came to Lebanon and took away the top of the cedar.
units.rightText: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A great eagle with great wings and long pinions, full of feathers, which had divers colors, came unto Lebanon, and took the top of the cedar:
leftNotes: 17:3 Pinions are the outer parts of a bird’s wings, including the flight feathers.

units.leftText: He plucked off its topmost shoot, carried it to the land of merchants, and planted it in a city of traders.
units.rightText: he cropped off the topmost of the young twigs thereof, and carried it unto a land of traffic; he set it in a city of merchants.

units.leftText: He took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fertile soil; he placed it by abundant waters and set it out like a willow.
units.rightText: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful soil; he placed it beside many waters; he set it as a willow-tree.
leftNotes: 17:5 Hebrew in a field of seed

units.leftText: It sprouted and became a spreading vine, low in height, with branches turned toward him; yet its roots remained where it stood. So it became a vine and yielded branches and sent out shoots.
units.rightText: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

units.leftText: But there was another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. And behold, this vine bent its roots toward him. It stretched out its branches to him from its planting bed, so that he might water it.
units.rightText: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend its roots toward him, and shot forth its branches toward him, from the beds of its plantation, that he might water it.

units.leftText: It had been planted in good soil by abundant waters in order to yield branches and bear fruit and become a splendid vine.’
units.rightText: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

units.leftText: So you are to tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Will it flourish? Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit so that it shrivels? All its foliage will wither! It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by its roots.
units.rightText: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it may wither; that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? and not by a strong arm or much people can it be raised from the roots thereof.

units.leftText: Even if it is transplanted, will it flourish? Will it not completely wither when the east wind strikes? It will wither on the bed where it sprouted.’” The Parable Explained
units.rightText: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the beds where it grew.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Now say to this rebellious house: ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’
units.rightText: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and brought them to him to Babylon.

units.leftText: He took a member of the royal family and made a covenant with him, putting him under oath. Then he carried away the leading men of the land,
units.rightText: And he took of the seed royal, and made a covenant with him; he also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land;
leftNotes: 17:13 Hebrew the royal seed

units.leftText: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to lift itself up, surviving only by keeping his covenant.
units.rightText: that the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

units.leftText: But this king rebelled against Babylon by sending his envoys to Egypt to ask for horses and a large army. Will he flourish? Will the one who does such things escape? Can he break a covenant and yet escape?’
units.rightText: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? shall he break the covenant, and yet escape?

units.leftText: ‘As surely as I live,’ declares the Lord GOD, ‘he will die in Babylon, in the land of the king who enthroned him, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke.
units.rightText: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

units.leftText: Pharaoh with his mighty army and vast horde will not help him in battle, when ramps are built and siege walls constructed to destroy many lives.
units.rightText: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts, to cut off many persons.

units.leftText: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Seeing that he gave his hand in pledge yet did all these things, he will not escape!’
units.rightText: For he hath despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet hath done all these things; he shall not escape.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, I will bring down upon his head My oath that he despised and My covenant that he broke.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, I will even bring it upon his own head.

units.leftText: I will spread My net over him and catch him in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment upon him there for the treason he committed against Me.
units.rightText: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

units.leftText: All his choice troops will fall by the sword, and those who survive will be scattered to every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.’
units.rightText: And all his fugitives in all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward every wind: and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
leftNotes: 17:21 Many Hebrew manuscripts; MT All his fleeing troops

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will take a shoot from the lofty top of the cedar, and I will set it out. I will pluck a tender sprig from its topmost shoots, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also take of the lofty top of the cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it upon a high and lofty mountain:

units.leftText: I will plant it on the mountain heights of Israel so that it will bear branches; it will yield fruit and become a majestic cedar. Birds of every kind will nest under it, taking shelter in the shade of its branches.
units.rightText: in the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it; and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all birds of every wing; in the shade of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

units.leftText: Then all the trees of the field will know that I am the LORD. I bring the tall tree down and make the low tree tall. I dry up the green tree and make the withered tree flourish. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I have done it.’”
units.rightText: And all the trees of the field shall know that I, Jehovah, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I, Jehovah, have spoken and have done it.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,

units.leftText: “What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge’?
units.rightText: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?

units.leftText: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.
units.rightText: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.

units.leftText: Behold, every soul belongs to Me; both father and son are Mine. The soul who sins is the one who will die.
units.rightText: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

units.leftText: Now suppose a man is righteous and does what is just and right:
units.rightText: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

units.leftText: He does not eat at the mountain or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife or approach a woman during her period.
units.rightText: and hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbor’s wife, neither hath come near to a woman in her impurity,

units.leftText: He does not oppress another, but restores the pledge to the debtor. He does not commit robbery, but gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing.
units.rightText: and hath not wronged any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath taken nought by robbery, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

units.leftText: He does not engage in usury or take excess interest, but he withholds his hand from iniquity and executes true justice between men.
units.rightText: he that hath not given forth upon interest, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true justice between man and man,

units.leftText: He follows My statutes and faithfully keeps My ordinances. That man is righteous; surely he will live, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept mine ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Now suppose that man has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these things,
units.rightText: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth any one of these things,

units.leftText: though the father has done none of them: Indeed, the son eats at the mountain and defiles his neighbor’s wife.
units.rightText: and that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbor’s wife,

units.leftText: He oppresses the poor and needy; he commits robbery and does not restore a pledge. He lifts his eyes to idols; he commits abominations.
units.rightText: hath wronged the poor and needy, hath taken by robbery, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

units.leftText: He engages in usury and takes excess interest. Will this son live? He will not! Since he has committed all these abominations, he will surely die; his blood will be on his own head.
units.rightText: hath given forth upon interest, and hath taken increase; shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

units.leftText: Now suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed, considers them, and does not do likewise:
units.rightText: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins, which he hath done, and feareth, and doeth not such like;

units.leftText: He does not eat at the mountain or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.
units.rightText: that hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbor’s wife,

units.leftText: He does not oppress another, or retain a pledge, or commit robbery. He gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing.
units.rightText: neither hath wronged any, hath not taken aught to pledge, neither hath taken by robbery, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

units.leftText: He withholds his hand from harming the poor and takes no interest or usury. He keeps My ordinances and follows My statutes. Such a man will not die for his father’s iniquity. He will surely live.
units.rightText: that hath withdrawn his hand from the poor, that hath not received interest nor increase, hath executed mine ordinances, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
leftNotes: 18:17 Hebrew; LXX He withholds his hand from iniquity

units.leftText: As for his father, he will die for his own iniquity, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what was wrong among his people.
units.rightText: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he shall die in his iniquity.

units.leftText: Yet you may ask, ‘Why shouldn’t the son bear the iniquity of his father?’ Since the son has done what is just and right, carefully observing all My statutes, he will surely live.
units.rightText: Yet say ye, Wherefore doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

units.leftText: The soul who sins is the one who will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of his father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of his son. The righteousness of the righteous man will fall upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked man will fall upon him.
units.rightText: The soul that sinneth, it shall die: the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

units.leftText: But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.
units.rightText: But if the wicked turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

units.leftText: None of the transgressions he has committed will be held against him. Because of the righteousness he has practiced, he will live.
units.rightText: None of his transgressions that he hath committed shall be remembered against him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

units.leftText: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Lord GOD. Wouldn’t I prefer that he turn from his ways and live?
units.rightText: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked? saith the Lord Jehovah; and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

units.leftText: But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, committing the same abominations as the wicked, will he live? None of the righteous acts he did will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness and sin he has committed, he will die.
units.rightText: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? None of his righteous deeds that he hath done shall be remembered: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

units.leftText: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear now, O house of Israel: Is it My way that is unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
units.rightText: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel: Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

units.leftText: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, he will die for this. He will die because of the iniquity he has committed.
units.rightText: When the righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth therein; in his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

units.leftText: But if a wicked man turns from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will save his life.
units.rightText: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

units.leftText: Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions he had committed, he will surely live; he will not die.
units.rightText: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

units.leftText: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are My ways unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
units.rightText: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

units.leftText: Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge you, each according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Repent and turn from all your transgressions, so that your iniquity will not become your downfall.
units.rightText: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord Jehovah. Return ye, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

units.leftText: Cast away from yourselves all the transgressions you have committed, and fashion for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, O house of Israel?
units.rightText: Cast away from you all your transgressions, wherein ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

units.leftText: For I take no pleasure in anyone’s death, declares the Lord GOD. So repent and live![’’]
units.rightText: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord Jehovah: wherefore turn yourselves, and live.

units.leftText: “As for you, take up a lament for the princes of Israel
units.rightText: Moreover, take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

units.leftText: and say: ‘What was your mother? A lioness among the lions! She lay down among the young lions; she reared her cubs.
units.rightText: and say, What was thy mother? A lioness: she couched among lions, in the midst of the young lions she nourished her whelps.

units.leftText: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
units.rightText: And she brought up one of her whelps: he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.

units.leftText: When the nations heard of him, he was trapped in their pit. With hooks they led him away to the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks unto the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: When she saw that she had waited in vain, that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
units.rightText: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.

units.leftText: He prowled among the lions, and became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
units.rightText: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.

units.leftText: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities. The land and everything in it shuddered at the sound of his roaring.
units.rightText: And he knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, because of the noise of his roaring.
leftNotes: 19:7 Or He knew their widows or He seized their widows

units.leftText: Then the nations set out against him from the provinces on every side. They spread their net over him; he was trapped in their pit.
units.rightText: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces; and they spread their net over him; he was taken in their pit.

units.leftText: With hooks they caged him and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into captivity so that his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.
units.rightText: And they put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

units.leftText: Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant waters.
units.rightText: Thy mother was like a vine, in thy blood, planted by the waters: it was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
leftNotes: 19:10 Some Hebrew manuscripts; most Hebrew manuscripts in your bloodline

units.leftText: It had strong branches, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick branches, conspicuous for its height and for its dense foliage.
units.rightText: And it had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and their stature was exalted among the thick boughs, and they were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.

units.leftText: But it was uprooted in fury, cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were stripped off and they withered; the fire consumed them.
units.rightText: But it was plucked up in fury, it was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit: its strong rods were broken off and withered; the fire consumed them.

units.leftText: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
units.rightText: And now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

units.leftText: Fire has gone out from its main branch and devoured its fruit; on it no strong branch remains fit for a ruler’s scepter.’ This is a lament and shall be used as a lament.”
units.rightText: And fire is gone out of the rods of its branches, it hath devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

units.leftText: In the seventh year, on the tenth day of the fifth month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down before me.
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Jehovah, and sat before me.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Have you come to inquire of Me? As surely as I live, I will not be consulted by you, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Is it to inquire of me that ye are come? As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

units.leftText: Will you judge them, will you judge them, son of man? Confront them with the abominations of their fathers
units.rightText: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers;

units.leftText: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore an oath to the descendants of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt. With an uplifted hand I said to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.’
units.rightText: and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when I chose Israel, and sware unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I sware unto them, saying, I am Jehovah your God;

units.leftText: On that day I swore to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands.
units.rightText: in that day I sware unto them, to bring them forth out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

units.leftText: And I said to them: ‘Each of you must throw away the abominations before his eyes, and you must not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’
units.rightText: And I said unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: But they rebelled against Me and refused to listen. None of them cast away the abominations before their eyes, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me; they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: But I acted for the sake of My name, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were living, in whose sight I had revealed Myself to Israel by bringing them out of the land of Egypt. Israel’s Rebellion in the Wilderness
units.rightText: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: So I brought them out of the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.
units.rightText: So I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

units.leftText: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances— for the man who does these things will live by them.
units.rightText: And I gave them my statutes, and showed them mine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live in them.
leftNotes: 20:11 See Leviticus 18:5|LEV 18:5*; also in Ezekiel 20:13 and 21.

units.leftText: I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between us, so that they would know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
units.rightText: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Jehovah that sanctifieth them.

units.leftText: Yet the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not follow My statutes and they rejected My ordinances— though the man who does these things will live by them — and they utterly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and put an end to them in the wilderness.
units.rightText: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they rejected mine ordinances, which if a man keep, he shall live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly profaned. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

units.leftText: But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
units.rightText: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

units.leftText: Moreover, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them— a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands —
units.rightText: Moreover also I sware unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;

units.leftText: because they kept rejecting My ordinances, refusing to walk in My statutes, and profaning My Sabbaths; for their hearts continually went after their idols.
units.rightText: because they rejected mine ordinances, and walked not in my statutes, and profaned my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

units.leftText: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or bring them to an end in the wilderness.
units.rightText: Nevertheless mine eye spared them, and I destroyed them not, neither did I make a full end of them in the wilderness.

units.leftText: In the wilderness I said to their children: ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
units.rightText: And I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their ordinances, nor defile yourselves with their idols.

units.leftText: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them.
units.rightText: I am Jehovah your God: walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them;

units.leftText: Keep My Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’
units.rightText: and hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: But the children rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes or carefully observe My ordinances — though the man who does these things will live by them — and they profaned My Sabbaths. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the wilderness.
units.rightText: But the children rebelled against me; they walked not in my statutes, neither kept mine ordinances to do them, which if a man do, he shall live in them; they profaned my sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

units.leftText: But I withheld My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
units.rightText: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them forth.

units.leftText: However, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands.
units.rightText: Moreover I sware unto them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations, and disperse them through the countries;

units.leftText: For they did not practice My ordinances, but they rejected My statutes and profaned My Sabbaths, fixing their eyes on the idols of their fathers.
units.rightText: because they had not executed mine ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

units.leftText: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and ordinances by which they could not live.
units.rightText: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances wherein they should not live;

units.leftText: And I pronounced them unclean through their gifts — the sacrifice of every firstborn in the fire — so that I might devastate them, in order that they would know that I am the LORD. Israel’s Rebellion in the Land
units.rightText: and I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: In this way also your fathers blasphemed Me by their unfaithfulness against Me.
units.rightText: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In this moreover have your fathers blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

units.leftText: When I brought them into the land that I swore to give them and they saw any high hill or leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, presented offerings that provoked Me, sent up their fragrant incense, and poured out their drink offerings.
units.rightText: For when I had brought them into the land, which I sware to give unto them, then they saw every high hill, and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering; there also they made their sweet savor, and they poured out there their drink-offerings.

units.leftText: So I asked them: ‘What is this high place to which you go?’ (And to this day it is called Bamah. )
units.rightText: Then I said unto them, What meaneth the high place whereunto ye go? So the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
leftNotes: 20:29 Bamah means high place.

units.leftText: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did, prostituting yourselves with their abominations?
units.rightText: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Do ye pollute yourselves after the manner of your fathers? and play ye the harlot after their abominations?

units.leftText: When you offer your gifts, sacrificing your sons in the fire, you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. So should I be consulted by you, O house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will not be consulted by you!
