units.rightText: and when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, do ye pollute yourselves with all your idols unto this day? and shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you;
leftNotes: 20:31 Literally making your sons pass through the fire

units.leftText: When you say, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the peoples of the lands, serving wood and stone,’ what you have in mind will never come to pass. Judgment and Restoration
units.rightText: and that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, in that ye say, We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

units.leftText: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will rule over you.
units.rightText: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, will I be king over you.

units.leftText: With a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered.
units.rightText: And I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out;
leftNotes: 20:34 LXX receive you; see also 2 Corinthians 6:17|2CO 6:17*.

units.leftText: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, where I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
units.rightText: and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there will I enter into judgment with you face to face.

units.leftText: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Like as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I enter into judgment with you, saith the Lord Jehovah.
leftNotes: 20:36 Or in the wilderness after bringing them out of Egypt

units.leftText: I will make you pass under the rod and will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
units.rightText: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant;

units.leftText: And I will purge you of those who rebel and transgress against Me. I will bring them out of the land in which they dwell, but they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: and I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me; I will bring them forth out of the land where they sojourn, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: And as for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you. But afterward, you will surely listen to Me, and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols.
units.rightText: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Go ye, serve every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me; but my holy name shall ye no more profane with your gifts, and with your idols.

units.leftText: For on My holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve Me in the land. There I will accept them and will require your offerings and choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.
units.rightText: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them, serve me in the land: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the first-fruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

units.leftText: When I bring you from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered, I will accept you as a pleasing aroma. And I will show My holiness through you in the sight of the nations.
units.rightText: As a sweet savor will I accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.

units.leftText: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land that I swore to give your fathers.
units.rightText: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I sware to give unto your fathers.

units.leftText: There you will remember your ways and all the deeds with which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evils you have done.
units.rightText: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have polluted yourselves; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

units.leftText: Then you will know, O house of Israel, that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you for the sake of My name and not according to your wicked ways and corrupt acts, declares the Lord GOD.” A Prophecy against the South
units.rightText: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, preach against it, and prophesy against the forest of the Negev.
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the South;
leftNotes: 20:46 Hebrew toward Teman

units.leftText: Say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of the LORD! This is what the Lord GOD says: I am about to ignite in you a fire, and it will devour all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and by it every face from south to north will be scorched.
units.rightText: and say to the forest of the South, Hear the word of Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burnt thereby.

units.leftText: Then all people will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it; it will not be quenched.”
units.rightText: And all flesh shall see that I, Jehovah, have kindled it; it shall not be quenched.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD, they are saying of me, ‘Is he not just telling parables?’”
units.rightText: Then said I, Ah Lord Jehovah! they say of me, Is he not a speaker of parables?

units.leftText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuaries. Prophesy against the land of Israel
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel;

units.leftText: and tell her that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am against you, and I will draw My sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.
units.rightText: and say to the land of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

units.leftText: Because I will cut off both the righteous and the wicked, My sword will be unsheathed against everyone from south to north.
units.rightText: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

units.leftText: Then all flesh will know that I, the LORD, have taken My sword from its sheath, not to return it again.’
units.rightText: and all flesh shall know that I, Jehovah, have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath; it shall not return any more.

units.leftText: But you, son of man, groan! Groan before their eyes with a broken heart and bitter grief.
units.rightText: Sigh therefore, thou son of man; with the breaking of thy loins and with bitterness shalt thou sigh before their eyes.

units.leftText: And when they ask, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you are to say, ‘Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt, and every hand will go limp. Every spirit will faint, and every knee will turn to water.’ Yes, it is coming and it will surely happen, declares the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt say, Because of the tidings, for it cometh; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and it shall be done, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord says: ‘A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished —
units.rightText: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith Jehovah: Say, A sword, a sword, it is sharpened, and also furbished;

units.leftText: it is sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! Should we rejoice in the scepter of My son? The sword despises every such stick.
units.rightText: it is sharpened that it may make a slaughter; it is furbished that it may be as lightning: shall we then make mirth? the rod of my son, it contemneth every tree.

units.leftText: The sword is appointed to be polished, to be grasped in the hand. It is sharpened and polished, to be placed in the hand of the slayer.
units.rightText: And it is given to be furbished, that it may be handled: the sword, it is sharpened, yea, it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

units.leftText: Cry out and wail, O son of man, for the sword is wielded against My people; it is against all the princes of Israel! They are tossed to the sword with My people; therefore strike your thigh.
units.rightText: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is upon my people, it is upon all the princes of Israel: they are delivered over to the sword with my people; smite therefore upon thy thigh.
leftNotes: 21:12 Or beat your breast

units.leftText: Surely testing will come! And what if even the scepter, which the sword despises, does not continue?’ declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: For there is a trial; and what if even the rod that contemneth shall be no more? saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: ‘So then, son of man, prophesy and strike your hands together. Let the sword strike two times, even three. It is a sword that slays, a sword of great slaughter closing in on every side!
units.rightText: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thy hands together; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the deadly wounded: it is the sword of the great one that is deadly wounded, which entereth into their chambers.

units.leftText: So that their hearts may melt and many may stumble, I have appointed at all their gates a sword for slaughter. Yes, it is ready to flash like lightning; it is drawn for slaughter.
units.rightText: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied: ah! it is made as lightning, it is pointed for slaughter.

units.leftText: Slash to the right; set your blade to the left— wherever your blade is directed.
units.rightText: Gather thee together, go to the right, set thyself in array, go to the left, whithersoever thy face is set.

units.leftText: I too will strike My hands together, and I will satisfy My wrath.’ I, the LORD, have spoken.”
units.rightText: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,

units.leftText: “Now you, son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same land. And make a signpost where the road branches off to each city.
units.rightText: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come; they twain shall come forth out of one land: and mark out a place, mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

units.leftText: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites, and another against Judah into fortified Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Thou shalt appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

units.leftText: For the king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He shakes the arrows, he consults the idols, he examines the liver.
units.rightText: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he shook the arrows to and fro, he consulted the teraphim, he looked in the liver.

units.leftText: In his right hand appears the portent for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to call for the slaughter, to lift a battle cry, to direct the battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp, and to erect a siege wall.
units.rightText: In his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, to build forts.

units.leftText: It will seem like a false omen to the eyes of those who have sworn allegiance to him, but it will draw attention to their guilt and take them captive.
units.rightText: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths unto them; but he bringeth iniquity to remembrance, that they may be taken.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have drawn attention to your guilt, exposing your transgressions, so that your sins are revealed in all your deeds — because you have come to remembrance — you shall be taken in hand.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

units.leftText: And you, O profane and wicked prince of Israel, the day has come for your final punishment.’
units.rightText: And thou, O deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day is come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Remove the turban, and take off the crown. Things will not remain as they are: Exalt the lowly and bring low the exalted.
units.rightText: thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Remove the mitre, and take off the crown; this shall be no more the same; exalt that which is low, and abase that which is high.

units.leftText: A ruin, a ruin, I will make it a ruin! And it will not be restored until the arrival of Him to whom it belongs, to whom I have assigned the right of judgment. ’
units.rightText: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it: this also shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
leftNotes: 21:27 Or of Him to whom it rightfully belongs, to whom I have given it.

units.leftText: Now prophesy, son of man, and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says concerning the Ammonites and their contempt: ‘A sword! A sword is drawn for slaughter, polished to consume, to flash like lightning—
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and say thou, A sword, a sword is drawn, for the slaughter it is furbished, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

units.leftText: while they offer false visions for you and lying divinations about you— to be placed on the necks of the wicked who are slain, whose day has come, the time of their final punishment.
units.rightText: while they see for thee false visions, while they divine lies unto thee, to lay thee upon the necks of the wicked that are deadly wounded, whose day is come in the time of the iniquity of the end.

units.leftText: Return the sword to its sheath! In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.
units.rightText: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy birth, will I judge thee.

units.leftText: I will pour out My anger upon you; I will breathe the fire of My fury against you; I will hand you over to brutal men, skilled in destruction.
units.rightText: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee; I will blow upon thee with the fire of my wrath; and I will deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, skilful to destroy.

units.leftText: You will be fuel for the fire. Your blood will stain your own land. You will not be remembered, for I, the LORD, have spoken.’”
units.rightText: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “As for you, son of man, will you judge her? Will you pass judgment on the city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her abominations
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? then cause her to know all her abominations.

units.leftText: and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘O city who brings her own doom by shedding blood within her walls and making idols to defile herself,
units.rightText: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A city that sheddeth blood in the midst of her, that her time may come, and that maketh idols against herself to defile her!

units.leftText: you are guilty of the blood you have shed, and you are defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands.
units.rightText: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed, and art defiled in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

units.leftText: Those near and far will mock you, O infamous city, full of turmoil.
units.rightText: Those that are near, and those that are far from thee, shall mock thee, thou infamous one and full of tumult.

units.leftText: See how every prince of Israel within you has used his power to shed blood.
units.rightText: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one according to his power, have been in thee to shed blood.

units.leftText: Father and mother are treated with contempt. Within your walls the foreign resident is exploited, the fatherless and the widow are oppressed.
units.rightText: In thee have they set light by father and mother; in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the sojourner; in thee have they wronged the fatherless and the widow.

units.leftText: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.
units.rightText: Thou hast despised my holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

units.leftText: Among you are slanderous men bent on bloodshed; within you are those who eat on the mountain shrines and commit acts of indecency.
units.rightText: Slanderous men have been in thee to shed blood; and in thee they have eaten upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they have committed lewdness.

units.leftText: In you they have uncovered the nakedness of their fathers; in you they violate women during their menstrual impurity.
units.rightText: In thee have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness; in thee have they humbled her that was unclean in her impurity.

units.leftText: One man commits an abomination with his neighbor’s wife; another wickedly defiles his daughter-in-law; and yet another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.
units.rightText: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

units.leftText: In you they take bribes to shed blood. You engage in usury, take excess interest, and extort your neighbors. But Me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: In thee have they taken bribes to shed blood; thou hast taken interest and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbors by oppression, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Now look, I strike My hands together against your unjust gain and against the blood you have shed in your midst.
units.rightText: Behold, therefore, I have smitten my hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

units.leftText: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will act.
units.rightText: Can thy heart endure, or can thy hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and will do it.

units.leftText: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you throughout the lands; I will purge your uncleanness.
units.rightText: And I will scatter thee among the nations, and disperse thee through the countries; and I will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

units.leftText: And when you have defiled yourself in the eyes of the nations, then you will know that I am the LORD.’” The Refining Furnace
units.rightText: And thou shalt be profaned in thyself, in the sight of the nations; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 22:16 Or And when I have allotted you your inheritance

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.
units.rightText: Son of man, the house of Israel is become dross unto me: all of them are brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because all of you have become dross, behold, I will gather you into Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: Just as one gathers silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin into the furnace to melt with a fiery blast, so I will gather you in My anger and wrath, leave you there, and melt you.
units.rightText: As they gather silver and brass and iron and lead and tin into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.

units.leftText: Yes, I will gather you together and blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and you will be melted within the city.
units.rightText: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

units.leftText: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted within the city. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath upon you.’” Israel’s Wicked Leaders
units.rightText: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have poured out my wrath upon you.

units.leftText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, say to her, ‘In the day of indignation, you are a land that has not been cleansed, upon which no rain has fallen.’
units.rightText: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art a land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

units.leftText: The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour the people, seize the treasures and precious things, and multiply the widows within her.
units.rightText: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey: they have devoured souls; they take treasure and precious things; they have made her widows many in the midst thereof.
leftNotes: 22:25 LXX; Hebrew prophets

units.leftText: Her priests do violence to My law and profane My holy things. They make no distinction between the holy and the common, and they fail to distinguish between the clean and the unclean. They disregard My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
units.rightText: Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

units.leftText: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood, and destroying lives for dishonest gain.
units.rightText: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

units.leftText: Her prophets whitewash these deeds by false visions and lying divinations, saying, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.
units.rightText: And her prophets have daubed for them with untempered mortar, seeing false visions, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, when Jehovah hath not spoken.

units.leftText: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery. They have oppressed the poor and needy and have exploited the foreign resident without justice.
units.rightText: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery; yea, they have vexed the poor and needy, and have oppressed the sojourner wrongfully.

units.leftText: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, so that I should not destroy it. But I found no one.
units.rightText: And I sought for a man among them, that should build up the wall, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found none.

units.leftText: So I have poured out My indignation upon them and consumed them with the fire of My fury. I have brought their ways down upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I brought upon their heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother,
units.rightText: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

units.leftText: and they played in Egypt, prostituting themselves from their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their virgin bosoms caressed.
units.rightText: and they played the harlot in Egypt; they played the harlot in their youth; there were their breasts pressed, and there was handled the bosom of their virginity.

units.leftText: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah. They became Mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their identities, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
units.rightText: And the names of them were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister: and they became mine, and they bare sons and daughters. And as for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
leftNotes: 23:4 Oholah means her own tent or she worships at a tent shrine, a metaphor for Samaria as an adulteress with Assyria.
23:4 Oholibah means the tent is in her or she is a tent shrine, a metaphor for Jerusalem as an adulterous wife.

units.leftText: Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians — warriors
units.rightText: And Oholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,

units.leftText: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all desirable young men, horsemen mounted on steeds.
units.rightText: who were clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

units.leftText: She offered sexual favors to all the elite of Assyria. She defiled herself with all the idols of those for whom she lusted.
units.rightText: And she bestowed her whoredoms upon them, the choicest men of Assyria all of them; and on whomsoever she doted, with all their idols she defiled herself.

units.leftText: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when men slept with her in her youth, caressed her virgin bosom, and poured out their lust upon her.
units.rightText: Neither hath she left her whoredoms since the days of Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her, and they handled the bosom of her virginity; and they poured out their whoredom upon her.

units.leftText: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, the Assyrians for whom she lusted.
units.rightText: Wherefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

units.leftText: They exposed her nakedness, seized her sons and daughters, and put her to the sword. Thus she became a byword among women, and they executed judgment against her.
units.rightText: These uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters; and her they slew with the sword: and she became a byword among women; for they executed judgments upon her.

units.leftText: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.
units.rightText: And her sister Oholibah saw this, yet was she more corrupt in her doting than she, and in her whoredoms which were more than the whoredoms of her sister.

units.leftText: She too lusted after the Assyrians — governors and commanders, warriors dressed in splendor, horsemen riding on steeds, all desirable young men.
units.rightText: She doted upon the Assyrians, governors and rulers, her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

units.leftText: And I saw that she too had defiled herself; both of them had taken the same path.
units.rightText: And I saw that she was defiled; they both took one way.

units.leftText: But Oholibah carried her prostitution even further. She saw the men portrayed on the wall, images of the Chaldeans, engraved in vermilion,
units.rightText: And she increased her whoredoms; for she saw men portrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,
leftNotes: 23:14 That is, the Babylonians

units.leftText: wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
units.rightText: girded with girdles upon their loins, with flowing turbans upon their heads, all of them princes to look upon, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their nativity.
leftNotes: 23:15 Or Babylonia; also in verse 16

units.leftText: At the sight of them, she lusted for them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
units.rightText: And as soon as she saw them she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

units.leftText: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. But after she had been defiled by them, she turned away in disgust.
units.rightText: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

units.leftText: When Oholibah openly prostituted herself and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.
units.rightText: So she uncovered her whoredoms, and uncovered her nakedness: then my soul was alienated from her, like as my soul was alienated from her sister.

units.leftText: Yet she multiplied her promiscuity, remembering the days of her youth, when she had prostituted herself in the land of Egypt
units.rightText: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, remembering the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: and lusted after their lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of stallions.
units.rightText: And she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

units.leftText: So you revisited the indecency of your youth, when the Egyptians caressed your bosom and pressed your young breasts. Oholibah to Be Plagued
units.rightText: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in the handling of thy bosom by the Egyptians for the breasts of thy youth.

units.leftText: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will incite your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust. And I will bring them against you from every side —
units.rightText: Therefore, O Oholibah, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy soul is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side:

units.leftText: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them— all desirable young men, governors and commanders, officers and men of renown, mounted on horses.
units.rightText: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; desirable young men, governors and rulers all of them, princes and men of renown, all of them riding upon horses.

units.leftText: They will come against you with a host of peoples, with weapons, chariots, and wagons. They will array themselves against you on every side with buckler and shield and helmet. I will delegate judgment to them, and they will punish you according to their own standards.
units.rightText: And they shall come against thee with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples; they shall set themselves against thee with buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will commit the judgment unto them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
leftNotes: 23:24 LXX They will all come against you from the north

units.leftText: And I will set My jealous rage against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and ears, and your survivors will fall by the sword. They will seize your sons and daughters, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.
units.rightText: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal with thee in fury; they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy residue shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

units.leftText: They will strip off your clothes and take your fine jewelry.
units.rightText: They shall also strip thee of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

units.leftText: So I will put an end to your indecency and prostitution, which began in the land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them or remember Egypt anymore.’
units.rightText: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt; so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Surely I will deliver you into the hands of those you hate, from whom you turned away in disgust.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy soul is alienated;

units.leftText: They will treat you with hatred, take all for which you have worked, and leave you naked and bare, so that the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your indecency and promiscuity
units.rightText: and they shall deal with thee in hatred, and shall take away all thy labor, and shall leave thee naked and bare; and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be uncovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

units.leftText: have brought these things upon you, because you have prostituted yourself with the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
units.rightText: These things shall be done unto thee, for that thou hast played the harlot after the nations, and because thou art polluted with their idols.

units.leftText: Because you have followed the path of your sister, I will put her cup into your hand.’
units.rightText: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thy hand.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You will drink your sister’s cup, a cup deep and wide. It will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou shalt drink of thy sister’s cup, which is deep and large; thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

units.leftText: You will be filled with drunkenness and grief, with a cup of devastation and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
units.rightText: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

units.leftText: You will drink it and drain it; you will dash it to pieces, and tear your breasts. For I have spoken,’ declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Thou shalt even drink it and drain it out, and thou shalt gnaw the sherds thereof, and shalt tear thy breasts; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten Me and have cast Me behind your back, you must bear the consequences of your indecency and prostitution.’” Judgment on Both Sisters
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
units.rightText: Jehovah said moreover unto me: Son of man, wilt thou judge Oholah and Oholibah? then declare unto them their abominations.

units.leftText: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to Me, in the fire as food for their idols.
units.rightText: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands; and with their idols have they committed adultery; and they have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass through the fire unto them to be devoured.
leftNotes: 23:37 Literally passed their children, whom they bore to Me, through the fire

units.leftText: They have also done this to Me: On that very same day, they defiled My sanctuary and profaned My Sabbaths.
units.rightText: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

units.leftText: On the very day they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My sanctuary to profane it. Yes, they did this inside My house.
units.rightText: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of my house.

units.leftText: Furthermore, you sisters sent messengers for men who came from afar; and behold, when they arrived, you bathed for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with jewelry.
units.rightText: And furthermore ye have sent for men that come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent, and, lo, they came; for whom thou didst wash thyself, paint thine eyes, and deck thyself with ornaments,
leftNotes: 23:40 Hebrew they sent

units.leftText: You sat on a couch of luxury with a table spread before it, on which you had set My incense and My oil,
units.rightText: and sit upon a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon thou didst set mine incense and mine oil.

units.leftText: accompanied by the sound of a carefree crowd. Drunkards were brought in from the desert along with men from the rabble, who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your head.
units.rightText: And the voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets upon the hands of them twain, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
leftNotes: 23:42 Or Sabeans

units.leftText: Then I said of her who had grown old in adulteries: ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is!’
units.rightText: Then said I of her that was old in adulteries, Now will they play the harlot with her, and she with them.

units.leftText: And they slept with her as with a prostitute; they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
units.rightText: And they went in unto her, as they go in unto a harlot: so went they in unto Oholah and unto Oholibah, the lewd women.

units.leftText: But righteous men will sentence them to the punishment of those who commit adultery and bloodshed, because they are adulteresses with blood on their hands.
units.rightText: And righteous men, they shall judge them with the judgment of adulteresses, and with the judgment of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Bring a mob against them and consign them to terror and plunder.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company against them, and will give them to be tossed to and fro and robbed.

units.leftText: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.
units.rightText: And the company shall stone them with stones, and despatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

units.leftText: So I will put an end to indecency in the land, and all the women will be admonished not to imitate your behavior.
units.rightText: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

units.leftText: They will repay you for your indecency, and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the ninth year, on the tenth day of the tenth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, write down today’s date, for on this very day the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this selfsame day: the king of Babylon drew close unto Jerusalem this selfsame day.

units.leftText: Now speak a parable to this rebellious house and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Put the pot on the fire; put it on and pour in the water.
units.rightText: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Set on the caldron, set it on, and also pour water into it:

units.leftText: Put in the pieces of meat, every good piece— thigh and shoulder — fill it with choice bones.
units.rightText: gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.

units.leftText: Take the choicest of the flock and pile the fuel beneath it. Bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.’
units.rightText: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the caldron; make it boil well; yea, let the bones thereof be boiled in the midst of it.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed, to the pot now rusted, whose rust will not come off! Empty it piece by piece; cast no lots for its contents.
units.rightText: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city, to the caldron whose rust is therein, and whose rust is not gone out of it! take out of it piece after piece; No lot is fallen upon it.
leftNotes: 24:6 Or let no lot fall upon it

units.leftText: For the blood she shed is still within her; she poured it out on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground to cover it with dust.
units.rightText: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the bare rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust.

units.leftText: In order to stir up wrath and take vengeance, I have placed her blood on the bare rock, so that it would not be covered.’
units.rightText: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood upon the bare rock, that it should not be covered.

units.leftText: Yes, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the kindling high.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.

units.leftText: Pile on the logs and kindle the fire; cook the meat well and mix in the spices; let the bones be burned.
units.rightText: Heap on the wood, make the fire hot, boil well the flesh, and make thick the broth, and let the bones be burned.

units.leftText: Set the empty pot on its coals until it becomes hot and its copper glows. Then its impurity will melt within; its rust will be consumed.
units.rightText: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that it may be hot, and the brass thereof may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the rust of it may be consumed.

units.leftText: It has frustrated every effort; its thick rust has not been removed, even by the fire.
units.rightText: She hath wearied herself with toil; yet her great rust goeth not forth out of her; her rust goeth not forth by fire.

units.leftText: Because of the indecency of your uncleanness I tried to cleanse you, but you would not be purified from your filthiness. You will not be pure again until My wrath against you has subsided.
units.rightText: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have cleansed thee and thou wast not cleansed, thou shalt not be cleansed from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my wrath toward thee to rest.

units.leftText: I, the LORD, have spoken; the time is coming, and I will act. I will not refrain or show pity, nor will I relent. I will judge you according to your ways and deeds,’ declares the Lord GOD.” Ezekiel’s Wife Dies
units.rightText: I, Jehovah, have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it: I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Also the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, behold, I am about to take away the desire of your eyes with a fatal blow. But you must not mourn or weep or let your tears flow.
units.rightText: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet thou shalt neither mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

units.leftText: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Put on your turban and strap your sandals on your feet; do not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.”
units.rightText: Sigh, but not aloud, make no mourning for the dead; bind thy headtire upon thee, and put thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.

units.leftText: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. And the next morning I did as I had been commanded.
units.rightText: So I spake unto the people in the morning; and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

units.leftText: Then the people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things you are doing mean to us?”
units.rightText: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?

units.leftText: So I answered them, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
units.rightText: Then I said unto them, The word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: Tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I am about to desecrate My sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and the delight of your soul. And the sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.’
units.rightText: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left behind shall fall by the sword.

units.leftText: Then you will do as I have done: You will not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.
units.rightText: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

units.leftText: Your turbans will remain on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep, but you will waste away because of your sins, and you will groan among yourselves.
units.rightText: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

units.leftText: ‘Thus Ezekiel will be a sign for you; you will do everything that he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’
units.rightText: Thus shall Ezekiel be unto you a sign; according to all that he hath done shall ye do: when this cometh, then shall ye know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: And you, son of man, know that on the day I take away their stronghold, their pride and joy — the desire of their eyes which uplifted their souls — and their sons and daughters as well,
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart, their sons and their daughters,

units.leftText: on that day a fugitive will come and tell you the news.
units.rightText: that in that day he that escapeth shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?

units.leftText: On that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped; you will speak and no longer be mute. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him that is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: so shalt thou be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them:

units.leftText: Tell the Ammonites to hear the word of the Lord GOD, for this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you exclaimed, “Aha!” when My sanctuary was profaned, when the land of Israel was laid waste, and when the house of Judah went into exile,
units.rightText: and say unto the children of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was made desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity:

units.leftText: therefore I will indeed give you as a possession to the people of the East. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I will deliver thee to the children of the east for a possession, and they shall set their encampments in thee, and make their dwellings in thee; they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

units.leftText: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and Ammon a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
units.rightText: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the children of Ammon a couching-place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 25:5 Hebrew and the Ammonites

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you clapped your hands and stomped your feet and rejoiced over the land of Israel with a heart full of contempt,
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast clapped thy hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the despite of thy soul against the land of Israel;

units.leftText: therefore I will indeed stretch out My hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.’ A Prophecy against Moab
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the nations; and I will cut thee off from the peoples, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Moab and Seir said, “Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,”
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the nations;
leftNotes: 25:8 LXX does not include and Seir.

units.leftText: therefore I will indeed expose the flank of Moab beginning with its frontier cities — Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim — the glory of the land.
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

units.leftText: I will give it along with the Ammonites as a possession to the people of the East, so that the Ammonites will no longer be remembered among the nations.
units.rightText: unto the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations:

units.leftText: So I will execute judgments on Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.’ A Prophecy against Edom
units.rightText: and I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Edom acted vengefully against the house of Judah, and in so doing incurred grievous guilt,
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

units.leftText: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast. I will make it a wasteland, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, I will stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; even unto Dedan shall they fall by the sword.

units.leftText: I will take My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel, and they will deal with Edom according to My anger and wrath. Then they will know My vengeance, declares the Lord GOD.’ A Prophecy against the Philistines
units.rightText: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel; and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my wrath; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because the Philistines acted in vengeance, taking vengeance with malice of soul to destroy Judah with ancient hostility,
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with despite of soul to destroy with perpetual enmity;

units.leftText: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant along the coast.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

units.leftText: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay My vengeance upon them.’”
units.rightText: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with wrathful rebukes; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

units.leftText: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
leftNotes: 26:1 Likely reading of the original Hebrew text; MT In the eleventh year

units.leftText: “Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken; it has swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will be filled,’
units.rightText: Son of man, because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gate of the peoples; she is turned unto me; I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste:

units.leftText: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, O Tyre, I am against you, and I will raise up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I am against thee, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth its waves to come up.

units.leftText: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and demolish her towers. I will scrape the soil from her and make her a bare rock.
units.rightText: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

units.leftText: She will become a place to spread nets in the sea, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD. She will become plunder for the nations,
units.rightText: She shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah; and she shall become a spoil to the nations.

units.leftText: and the villages on her mainland will be slain by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
units.rightText: And her daughters that are in the field shall be slain with the sword: and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with cavalry and a great company of troops.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and a company, and much people.
leftNotes: 26:7 Hebrew Nebuchadrezzar, a variant of Nebuchadnezzar (king of Babylon). The latter spelling is used throughout Ezekiel for consistency.

units.leftText: He will slaughter the villages of your mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp to your walls, and raise his shields against you.
units.rightText: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field; and he shall make forts against thee, and cast up a mound against thee, and raise up the buckler against thee.

units.leftText: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and tear down your towers with his axes.
units.rightText: And he shall set his battering engines against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

units.leftText: His multitude of horses will cover you in their dust.
units.rightText: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

units.leftText: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets. He will slaughter your people with the sword, and your mighty pillars will fall to the ground.
units.rightText: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets; he shall slay thy people with the sword; and the pillars of thy strength shall go down to the ground.

units.leftText: They will plunder your wealth and pillage your merchandise. They will demolish your walls, tear down your beautiful homes, and throw your stones and timber and soil into the water.
units.rightText: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise; and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses; and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the waters.

units.leftText: So I will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.
units.rightText: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

units.leftText: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread the fishing nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I, the LORD, have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.’
units.rightText: And I will make thee a bare rock; thou shalt be a place for the spreading of nets; thou shalt be built no more: for I Jehovah have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Will not the coastlands quake at the sound of your downfall, when the wounded groan at the slaughter in your midst?
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

units.leftText: All the princes of the sea will descend from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled over you.
units.rightText: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble every moment, and be astonished at thee.

units.leftText: Then they will lament for you, saying, “How you have perished, O city of renown inhabited by seafaring men— she who was powerful on the sea, along with her people, who imposed terror on all peoples!
units.rightText: And they shall take up a lamentation over thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, that was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, that caused their terror to be on all that dwelt there!
leftNotes: 26:17 Or on all her inhabitants

units.leftText: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall; the islands in the sea are dismayed by your demise.”’
units.rightText: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be dismayed at thy departure.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city like other deserted cities, and when I raise up the deep against you so that the mighty waters cover you,
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and the great waters shall cover thee;

units.leftText: then I will bring you down with those who descend to the Pit, to the people of antiquity. I will make you dwell in the earth below like the ancient ruins, with those who descend to the Pit, so that you will no longer be inhabited or set in splendor in the land of the living.
units.rightText: then will I bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make thee to dwell in the nether parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
leftNotes: 26:20 LXX or take your place

units.leftText: I will make you an object of horror, and you will be no more. You will be sought, but will never be found,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt no more have any being; though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Now you, son of man, take up a lament for Tyre.
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;

units.leftText: Tell Tyre, who dwells at the gateway to the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coasts, that this is what the Lord GOD says: You have said, O Tyre, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
units.rightText: and say unto Tyre, O thou that dwellest at the entry of the sea, that art the merchant of the peoples unto many isles, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou, O Tyre, hast said, I am perfect in beauty.

units.leftText: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders perfected your beauty.
units.rightText: Thy borders are in the heart of the seas; thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

units.leftText: They constructed all your planking with cypress from Senir. They took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
units.rightText: They have made all thy planks of fir-trees from Senir; they have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for thee.
leftNotes: 27:5 Or pine or juniper or fir
27:5 That is, Mount Hermon

units.leftText: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, inlaid with ivory.
units.rightText: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; they have made thy benches of ivory inlaid in boxwood, from the isles of Kittim.
leftNotes: 27:6 Hebrew Kittim

units.leftText: Of embroidered fine linen from Egypt they made your sail, which served as your banner. Of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah they made your awning.
units.rightText: Of fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was thy sail, that it might be to thee for an ensign; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was thine awning.

units.leftText: The men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen. Your men of skill, O Tyre, were there as your captains.
units.rightText: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were thy rowers: thy wise men, O Tyre, were in thee, they were thy pilots.

units.leftText: The elders of Gebal were aboard as shipwrights, repairing your leaks. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to barter for your merchandise.
units.rightText: The old men of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to deal in thy merchandise.

units.leftText: Men of Persia, Lydia, and Put served as warriors in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls; they gave you splendor.
units.rightText: Persia and Lud and Put were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

units.leftText: Men of Arvad and Helech manned your walls all around, and the men of Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields around your walls; they perfected your beauty.
units.rightText: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and valorous men were in thy towers; they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have perfected thy beauty.

units.leftText: Tarshish was your merchant because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead for your wares.
units.rightText: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded for thy wares.

units.leftText: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants. They exchanged slaves and bronze utensils for your merchandise.
units.rightText: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy traffickers; they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass for thy merchandise.
leftNotes: 27:13 That is, Greece

units.leftText: The men of Beth-togarmah exchanged horses, war horses, and mules for your wares.
units.rightText: They of the house of Togarmah traded for thy wares with horses and war-horses and mules.

units.leftText: The men of Dedan were your clients; many coastlands were your market; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.
units.rightText: The men of Dedan were thy traffickers; many isles were the mart of thy hand: they brought thee in exchange horns of ivory and ebony.
leftNotes: 27:15 Hebrew; LXX Rhodes

units.leftText: Aram was your customer because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies for your wares.
units.rightText: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of thy handiworks: they traded for thy wares with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and rubies.
leftNotes: 27:16 Most Hebrew manuscripts; some Hebrew manuscripts and Syriac Edom

units.leftText: Judah and the land of Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith, cakes and honey, oil and balm for your merchandise.
units.rightText: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy traffickers: they traded for thy merchandise wheat of Minnith, and pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

units.leftText: Because of your many products and your great wealth of goods, Damascus traded with you wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar,
units.rightText: Damascus was thy merchant for the multitude of thy handiworks, by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

units.leftText: and casks of wine from Izal for your wares. Wrought iron, cassia, and sweet cane were exchanged for your merchandise.
units.rightText: Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for thy wares: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were among thy merchandise.
leftNotes: 27:19 Probable reading; MT —and Dan and Javan from Uzal (traded) for your wares
27:19 Or calamus
27:19 Or were among your merchandise

units.leftText: Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.
units.rightText: Dedan was thy trafficker in precious cloths for riding.

units.leftText: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers, trading in lambs, rams, and goats.
units.rightText: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they were the merchants of thy hand; in lambs, and rams, and goats, in these were they thy merchants.

units.leftText: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your wares they exchanged gold, the finest of all spices, and precious stones.
units.rightText: The traffickers of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy traffickers; they traded for thy wares with the chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

units.leftText: Haran, Canneh, and Eden traded with you, and so did the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad.
units.rightText: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traffickers of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were thy traffickers.

units.leftText: In your marketplace they traded with you fine garments of blue, embroidered work, and multicolored rugs with cords tightly twisted and knotted.
units.rightText: These were thy traffickers in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

units.leftText: The ships of Tarshish carried your merchandise. And you were filled with heavy cargo in the heart of the sea.
units.rightText: The ships of Tarshish were thy caravans for thy merchandise: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
leftNotes: 27:25 Or A fleet of trading ships

units.leftText: Your oarsmen have brought you onto the high seas, but the east wind will shatter you in the heart of the sea.
units.rightText: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the heart of the seas.

units.leftText: Your wealth, wares, and merchandise, your sailors, captains, and shipwrights, your merchants and all the warriors within you, with all the other people on board, will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your downfall.
units.rightText: Thy riches, and thy wares, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the dealers in thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, with all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

units.leftText: The countryside will shake when your sailors cry out.
units.rightText: At the sound of the cry of thy pilots the suburbs shall shake.

units.leftText: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships. The sailors and all the captains of the sea will stand on the shore.
units.rightText: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships; they shall stand upon the land,

units.leftText: They will raise their voices for you and cry out bitterly. They will throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
units.rightText: and shall cause their voice to be heard over thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads; they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

units.leftText: They will shave their heads for you and wrap themselves in sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and bitter mourning.
units.rightText: and they shall make themselves bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee in bitterness of soul with bitter mourning.

units.leftText: As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament for you: ‘Who was ever like Tyre, silenced in the middle of the sea?
units.rightText: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, Who is there like Tyre, like her that is brought to silence in the midst of the sea?

units.leftText: When your wares went out to sea, you satisfied many nations. You enriched the kings of the earth with your abundant wealth and merchandise.
units.rightText: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many peoples; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

units.leftText: Now you are shattered by the seas in the depths of the waters; your merchandise and the people among you have gone down with you.
units.rightText: In the time that thou wast broken by the seas in the depths of the waters, thy merchandise and all thy company did fall in the midst of thee.

units.leftText: All the people of the coastlands are appalled over you. Their kings shudder with fear; their faces are contorted.
units.rightText: All the inhabitants of the isles are astonished at thee, and their kings are horribly afraid; they are troubled in their countenance.

units.leftText: Those who trade among the nations hiss at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’”
units.rightText: The merchants among the peoples hiss at thee; thou art become a terror, and thou shalt nevermore have any being.

units.leftText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, tell the ruler of Tyre that this is what the Lord GOD says: Your heart is proud, and you have said, ‘I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods in the heart of the sea.’ Yet you are a man and not a god, though you have regarded your heart as that of a god.
units.rightText: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyre, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thy heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art man, and not God, though thou didst set thy heart as the heart of God;—

units.leftText: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you!
units.rightText: behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that is hidden from thee;

units.leftText: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained your wealth and amassed gold and silver for your treasuries.
units.rightText: by thy wisdom and by thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures;

units.leftText: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, but your heart has grown proud because of it.
units.rightText: by thy great wisdom and by thy traffic hast thou increased thy riches, and thy heart is lifted up because of thy riches;—

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you regard your heart as the heart of a god,
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast set thy heart as the heart of God,

units.leftText: behold, I will bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and will defile your splendor.
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

units.leftText: They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.
units.rightText: They shall bring thee down to the pit; and thou shalt die the death of them that are slain, in the heart of the seas.

units.leftText: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who slay you? You will be only a man, not a god, in the hands of those who wound you.
units.rightText: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou art man, and not God, in the hand of him that woundeth thee.

units.leftText: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.” A Lament for the King of Tyre
units.rightText: Thou shalt die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
