units.leftText: “Son of man, take up a lament for the king of Tyre and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
units.rightText: Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

units.leftText: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every kind of precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald. Your mountings and settings were crafted in gold, prepared on the day of your creation.
units.rightText: Thou wast in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, the topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was in thee; in the day that thou wast created they were prepared.
leftNotes: 28:13 The precise identification of some of these gemstones is uncertain.
28:13 Or lapis lazuli

units.leftText: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you. You were on the holy mountain of God; you walked among the fiery stones.
units.rightText: Thou wast the anointed cherub that covereth: and I set thee, so that thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

units.leftText: From the day you were created you were blameless in your ways— until wickedness was found in you.
units.rightText: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till unrighteousness was found in thee.

units.leftText: By the vastness of your trade, you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I banished you, O guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.
units.rightText: By the abundance of thy traffic they filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore have I cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God; and I have destroyed thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

units.leftText: Your heart grew proud of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor; so I cast you to the earth; I made you a spectacle before kings.
units.rightText: Thy heart was lifted up because of thy beauty; thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I have cast thee to the ground; I have laid thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

units.leftText: By the multitude of your iniquities and the dishonesty of your trading you have profaned your sanctuaries. So I made fire come from within you, and it consumed you. I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the eyes of all who saw you.
units.rightText: By the multitude of thine iniquities, in the unrighteousness of thy traffic, thou hast profaned thy sanctuaries; therefore have I brought forth a fire from the midst of thee; it hath devoured thee, and I have turned thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

units.leftText: All the nations who know you are appalled over you. You have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’” A Prophecy against Sidon
units.rightText: All they that know thee among the peoples shall be astonished at thee: thou art become a terror, and thou shalt nevermore have any being.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her.
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

units.leftText: And you are to declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified within you. They will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments against her and demonstrate My holiness through her.
units.rightText: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Sidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

units.leftText: I will send a plague against her and shed blood in her streets; the slain will fall within her, while the sword is against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall fall in the midst of her, with the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: For the people of Israel will no longer face a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.’ The Restoration of Israel (Jeremiah 30:1–17|JER 30:1-17*)
units.rightText: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are round about them, that did despite unto them; and they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the nations, then shall they dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

units.leftText: And there they will dwell securely, build houses, and plant vineyards. They will dwell securely when I execute judgments against all those around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.’”
units.rightText: And they shall dwell securely therein; yea, they shall build houses, and plant vineyards, and shall dwell securely, when I have executed judgments upon all those that do them despite round about them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah their God.

units.leftText: In the tenth year, on the twelfth day of the tenth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt;

units.leftText: Speak to him and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Pharaoh king of Egypt, O great monster who lies among his rivers, who says, ‘The Nile is mine; I made it myself.’
units.rightText: speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lieth in the midst of his rivers, that hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.

units.leftText: But I will put hooks in your jaws and cause the fish of your streams to cling to your scales. I will haul you up out of your rivers, and all the fish of your streams will cling to your scales.
units.rightText: And I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales; and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, with all the fish of thy rivers which stick unto thy scales.

units.leftText: I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and will not be taken away or gathered for burial. I have given you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the air.
units.rightText: And I will cast thee forth into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open field; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered; I have given thee for food to the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the heavens.

units.leftText: Then all the people of Egypt will know that I am the LORD. For you were only a staff of reeds to the house of Israel.
units.rightText: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am Jehovah, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

units.leftText: When Israel took hold of you with their hands, you splintered, tearing all their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke, and their backs were wrenched. The Desolation of Egypt
units.rightText: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and didst rend all their shoulders; and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
leftNotes: 29:7 Syriac (see also LXX and Vulgate); Hebrew and you caused their loins to shake.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring a sword against you and cut off from you man and beast.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and will cut off from thee man and beast.

units.leftText: The land of Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: And the land of Egypt shall be a desolation and a waste; and they shall know that I am Jehovah. Because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it;

units.leftText: therefore I am against you and against your rivers. I will turn the land of Egypt into a ruin, a desolate wasteland from Migdol to Syene, and as far as the border of Cush.
units.rightText: therefore, behold, I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even unto the border of Ethiopia.
leftNotes: 29:10 That is, the upper Nile region

units.leftText: No foot of man or beast will pass through, and it will be uninhabited for forty years.
units.rightText: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

units.leftText: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation among desolate lands, and her cities will lie desolate for forty years among the ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries.
units.rightText: And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be a desolation forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations to which they were scattered.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the peoples whither they were scattered;

units.leftText: I will restore Egypt from captivity and bring them back to the land of Pathros, the land of their origin. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
units.rightText: and I will bring back the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
leftNotes: 29:14 Or restore the fortunes of Egypt

units.leftText: Egypt will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the nations. For I will diminish Egypt so that it will never again rule over the nations.
units.rightText: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it any more lift itself up above the nations: and I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

units.leftText: Egypt will never again be an object of trust for the house of Israel, but will remind them of their iniquity in turning to the Egyptians. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.” Egypt the Reward of Nebuchadnezzar
units.rightText: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance, when they turn to look after them: and they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to labor strenuously against Tyre. Every head was made bald and every shoulder made raw. But he and his army received no wages from Tyre for the labor they expended on it.
units.rightText: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet had he no wages, nor his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will carry off its wealth, seize its spoil, and remove its plunder. This will be the wages for his army.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall carry off her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

units.leftText: I have given him the land of Egypt as the reward for his labor, because it was done for Me, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: I have given him the land of Egypt as his recompense for which he served, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth to speak among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: In that day will I cause a horn to bud forth unto the house of Israel, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Wail, ‘Alas for that day!’
units.rightText: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Wail ye, Alas for the day!

units.leftText: For the day is near, the Day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
units.rightText: For the day is near, even the day of Jehovah is near; it shall be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.
leftNotes: 30:3 Hebrew does not include of doom.

units.leftText: A sword will come against Egypt, and there will be anguish in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt, its wealth is taken away, and its foundations are torn down.
units.rightText: And a sword shall come upon Egypt, and anguish shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt; and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
leftNotes: 30:4 That is, the upper Nile region; also in verses 5 and 9

units.leftText: Cush, Put, and Lud, and all the various peoples, as well as Libya and the men of the covenant land, will fall with Egypt by the sword.
units.rightText: Ethiopia, and Put, and Lud, and all the mingled people, and Cub, and the children of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
leftNotes: 30:5 Or Lydia

units.leftText: For this is what the LORD says: The allies of Egypt will fall, and her proud strength will collapse. From Migdol to Syene they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah: They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Seveneh shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.
leftNotes: 30:6 That is, Aswan; see Isaiah 49:12|ISA 49:12*

units.leftText: They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.
units.rightText: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

units.leftText: Then they will know that I am the LORD when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are shattered.
units.rightText: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.

units.leftText: On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to frighten Cush out of complacency. Anguish will come upon them on the day of Egypt’s doom. For it is indeed coming.
units.rightText: In that day shall messengers go forth from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid; and there shall be anguish upon them, as in the day of Egypt; for, lo, it cometh.
leftNotes: 30:9 Hebrew the day of Egypt

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

units.leftText: He and his people with him, the most ruthless of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
units.rightText: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought in to destroy the land; and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

units.leftText: I will make the streams dry up and sell the land to the wicked. By the hands of foreigners I will bring desolation upon the land and everything in it. I, the LORD, have spoken.
units.rightText: And I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. There will no longer be a prince in Egypt, and I will instill fear in that land.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis; and there shall be no more a prince from the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
leftNotes: 30:13 LXX; Hebrew Noph; also in verse 16

units.leftText: I will lay waste Pathros, set fire to Zoan, and execute judgment on Thebes.
units.rightText: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments upon No.
leftNotes: 30:14 Hebrew No; also in verses 15 and 16

units.leftText: I will pour out My wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the crowds of Thebes.
units.rightText: And I will pour my wrath upon Sin, the stronghold of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
leftNotes: 30:15 Hebrew Sin; also in verse 16

units.leftText: I will set fire to Egypt, Pelusium will writhe in anguish, Thebes will be split open, and Memphis will face daily distress.
units.rightText: And I will set a fire in Egypt: Sin shall be in great anguish, and No shall be broken up; and Memphis shall have adversaries in the day-time.

units.leftText: The young men of On and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and those cities will go into captivity.
units.rightText: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword; and these cities shall go into captivity.
leftNotes: 30:17 That is, Heliopolis and Bubastis, as in LXX; Hebrew Aven and Pi-beseth

units.leftText: The day will be darkened in Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt and her proud strength comes to an end. A cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
units.rightText: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall withdraw itself, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt, and the pride of her power shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

units.leftText: So I will execute judgment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.” Pharaoh’s Power Broken
units.rightText: Thus will I execute judgments upon Egypt; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the eleventh year, on the seventh day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. See, it has not been bound up for healing, or splinted for strength to hold the sword.
units.rightText: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it hath not been bound up, to apply healing medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it be strong to hold the sword.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break his arms, both the strong one and the one already broken, and will make the sword fall from his hand.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

units.leftText: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
units.rightText: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

units.leftText: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king and place My sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, who will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.
units.rightText: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.

units.leftText: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king, but Pharaoh’s arms will fall limp.
units.rightText: And I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon; and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them through the countries; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the third month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: ‘Who can be compared to your greatness?
units.rightText: Son of man, say unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude: Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

units.leftText: Look at Assyria, a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches that shaded the forest. It towered on high; its top was among the clouds.
units.rightText: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a forest-like shade, and of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

units.leftText: The waters made it grow; the deep springs made it tall, directing their streams all around its base and sending their channels to all the trees of the field.
units.rightText: The waters nourished it, the deep made it to grow: the rivers thereof ran round about its plantation; and it sent out its channels unto all the trees of the field.

units.leftText: Therefore it towered higher than all the trees of the field. Its branches multiplied, and its boughs grew long as it spread them out because of the abundant waters.
units.rightText: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied, and its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it shot them forth.

units.leftText: All the birds of the air nested in its branches, and all the beasts of the field gave birth beneath its boughs; all the great nations lived in its shade.
units.rightText: All the birds of the heavens made their nests in its boughs; and under its branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young; and under its shadow dwelt all great nations.

units.leftText: It was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its limbs, for its roots extended to abundant waters.
units.rightText: Thus was it fair in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

units.leftText: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it; the cypresses could not compare with its branches, nor the plane trees match its boughs. No tree in the garden of God could compare with its beauty.
units.rightText: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it; the fir-trees were not like its boughs, and the plane-trees were not as its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like unto it in its beauty.
leftNotes: 31:8 Or pines or junipers or firs
31:8 Possibly chestnut or juniper

units.leftText: I made it beautiful with its many branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden, which were in the garden of God.’
units.rightText: I made it fair by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Since it became great in height and set its top among the clouds, and it grew proud on account of its height,
units.rightText: Therefore thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because thou art exalted in stature, and he hath set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
leftNotes: 31:10 Hebrew you became great
31:10 Or through the thick boughs

units.leftText: I delivered it into the hand of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with it according to its wickedness. I have banished it.
units.rightText: I will even deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations; he shall surely deal with him; I have driven him out for his wickedness.

units.leftText: Foreigners, the most ruthless of the nations, cut it down and left it. Its branches have fallen on the mountains and in every valley; its boughs lay broken in all the earth’s ravines. And all the peoples of the earth left its shade and abandoned it.
units.rightText: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land; and all the peoples of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

units.leftText: All the birds of the air nested on its fallen trunk, and all the beasts of the field lived among its boughs.
units.rightText: Upon his ruin all the birds of the heavens shall dwell, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches;

units.leftText: This happened so that no other trees by the waters would become great in height and set their tops among the clouds, and no other well-watered trees would reach them in height. For they have all been consigned to death, to the depths of the earth, among the mortals who descend to the Pit.’
units.rightText: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, neither set their top among the thick boughs, nor that their mighty ones stand up in their height, even all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘On the day it was brought down to Sheol, I caused mourning. I covered the deep because of it; I held back its rivers; its abundant waters were restrained. I made Lebanon mourn for it, and all the trees of the field fainted because of it.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when he went down to Sheol I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the rivers thereof; and the great waters were stayed; and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

units.leftText: I made the nations quake at the sound of its downfall, when I cast it down to Sheol with those who descend to the Pit.
units.rightText: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with them that descend into the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

units.leftText: They too descended with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword. As its allies they had lived in its shade among the nations.
units.rightText: They also went down into Sheol with him unto them that are slain by the sword; yea, they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the nations.

units.leftText: Who then is like you in glory and greatness among the trees of Eden? You also will be brought down to the depths of the earth to be with the trees of Eden. You will lie among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: ‘You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas. You thrash about in your rivers, churning up the waters with your feet and muddying the streams.’
units.rightText: Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou wast likened unto a young lion of the nations: yet art thou as a monster in the seas; and thou didst break forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will draw you up in My net.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will spread out my net upon thee with a company of many peoples; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

units.leftText: I will abandon you on the land and hurl you into the open field. I will cause all the birds of the air to settle upon you, and all the beasts of the earth to eat their fill of you.
units.rightText: And I will leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the birds of the heavens to settle upon thee, and I will satisfy the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

units.leftText: I will put your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.
units.rightText: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.
leftNotes: 32:5 Or your lofty stature

units.leftText: I will drench the land with the flow of your blood, all the way to the mountains — the ravines will be filled.
units.rightText: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the watercourses shall be full of thee.

units.leftText: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
units.rightText: And when I shall extinguish thee, I will cover the heavens, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give its light.

units.leftText: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you, and I will bring darkness upon your land,’ declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: ‘I will trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring about your destruction among the nations, in countries you do not know.
units.rightText: I will also vex the hearts of many peoples, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.
leftNotes: 32:9 Hebrew; LXX when I lead you into captivity among the nations, into countries

units.leftText: I will cause many peoples to be appalled over you, and their kings will shudder in horror because of you when I brandish My sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.’
units.rightText: Yea, I will make many peoples amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you!
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

units.leftText: I will make your hordes fall by the swords of the mighty, the most ruthless of all nations. They will ravage the pride of Egypt and all her multitudes will be destroyed.
units.rightText: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall; the terrible of the nations are they all: and they shall bring to nought the pride of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

units.leftText: I will slaughter all her cattle beside the abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle hooves will disturb them.
units.rightText: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside many waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

units.leftText: Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil,’ declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Then will I make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: ‘When I make the land of Egypt a desolation and empty it of all that filled it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.’
units.rightText: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: This is the lament they will chant for her; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her multitudes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.” Egypt Cast into the Pit
units.rightText: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament; the daughters of the nations shall lament therewith; over Egypt, and over all her multitude, shall they lament therewith, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
leftNotes: 32:17 Presumably the fifteenth day of the twelfth month (see verse 1); LXX on the fifteenth day of the first month.

units.leftText: “Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt, and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit:
units.rightText: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

units.leftText: Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!
units.rightText: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

units.leftText: They will fall among those slain by the sword. The sword is appointed! Let them drag her away along with all her multitudes.
units.rightText: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword; draw her away and all her multitudes.

units.leftText: Mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol about Egypt and her allies: ‘They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.’
units.rightText: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of Sheol with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie still, even the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

units.leftText: Assyria is there with her whole company; her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword.
units.rightText: Asshur is there and all her company; her graves are round about her; all of them slain, fallen by the sword;

units.leftText: Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who once spread terror in the land of the living.
units.rightText: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is round about her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

units.leftText: Elam is there with all her multitudes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who went down uncircumcised to the earth below, who once spread their terror in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit.
units.rightText: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

units.leftText: Among the slain they prepare a resting place for Elam with all her hordes, with her graves all around her. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, although their terror was once spread in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit. They are placed among the slain.
units.rightText: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude; her graves are round about her; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that are slain.

units.leftText: Meshech and Tubal are there with all their multitudes, with their graves all around them. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
units.rightText: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude; their graves are round about them; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

units.leftText: They do not lie down with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads, whose shields rested on their bones, although the terror of the mighty was once in the land of the living.
units.rightText: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, that are gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war, and have laid their swords under their heads, and their iniquities are upon their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
leftNotes: 32:27 LXX; Hebrew warriors of the uncircumcised
32:27 Likely reading of the original Hebrew text; MT iniquities

units.leftText: But you too will be shattered and lie down among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.
units.rightText: But thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain by the sword.

units.leftText: Edom is there, and all her kings and princes, who despite their might are laid among those slain by the sword. They lie down with the uncircumcised, with those who descend to the Pit.
units.rightText: There is Edom, her kings and all her princes, who in their might are laid with them that are slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

units.leftText: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit.
units.rightText: There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who are gone down with the slain; in the terror which they caused by their might they are put to shame; and they lie uncircumcised with them that are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

units.leftText: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude— Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: For I have put his terror in the land of the living; and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, speak to your people and tell them: ‘Suppose I bring the sword against a land, and the people of that land choose a man from among them, appointing him as their watchman,
units.rightText: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman;

units.leftText: and he sees the sword coming against that land and blows the ram’s horn to warn the people.
units.rightText: if, when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

units.leftText: Then if anyone hears the sound of the horn but fails to heed the warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
units.rightText: then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning, if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

units.leftText: Since he heard the sound of the horn but failed to heed the warning, his blood will be on his own head. If he had heeded the warning, he would have saved his life.
units.rightText: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him; whereas if he had taken warning, he would have delivered his soul.

units.leftText: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the horn to warn the people, and the sword comes and takes away a life, then that one will be taken away in his iniquity, but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood.’
units.rightText: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned, and the sword come, and take any person from among them; he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.

units.leftText: As for you, O son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me.
units.rightText: So thou, son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

units.leftText: If I say to the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ but you do not speak out to dissuade him from his way, then that wicked man will die in his iniquity, yet I will hold you accountable for his blood.
units.rightText: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die, and thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way; that wicked man shall die in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at thy hand.

units.leftText: But if you warn the wicked man to turn from his way, and he does not turn from it, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved your life. The Message of the Watchman
units.rightText: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he turn not from his way; he shall die in his iniquity, but thou hast delivered thy soul.

units.leftText: Now as for you, son of man, tell the house of Israel that this is what they have said: ‘Our transgressions and our sins are heavy upon us, and we are wasting away because of them! How can we live?’
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, say unto the house of Israel: Thus ye speak, saying, Our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and we pine away in them; how then can we live?

units.leftText: Say to them: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked should turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?’
units.rightText: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

units.leftText: Therefore, son of man, say to your people: ‘The righteousness of the righteous man will not deliver him in the day of his transgression; neither will the wickedness of the wicked man cause him to stumble on the day he turns from his wickedness. Nor will the righteous man be able to survive by his righteousness on the day he sins.’
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall he that is righteous be able to live thereby in the day that he sinneth.

units.leftText: If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live, but he then trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, then none of his righteous works will be remembered; he will die because of the iniquity he has committed.
units.rightText: When I say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his righteousness, and commit iniquity, none of his righteous deeds shall be remembered; but in his iniquity that he hath committed, therein shall he die.

units.leftText: But if I tell the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ and he turns from his sin and does what is just and right—
units.rightText: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

units.leftText: if he restores a pledge, makes restitution for what he has stolen, and walks in the statutes of life without practicing iniquity— then he will surely live; he will not die.
units.rightText: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

units.leftText: None of the sins he has committed will be held against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.
units.rightText: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be remembered against him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

units.leftText: Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.
units.rightText: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

units.leftText: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will die for it.
units.rightText: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die therein.

units.leftText: But if a wicked man turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live because of this.
units.rightText: And when the wicked turneth from his wickedness, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

units.leftText: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.” Word of Jerusalem’s Fall
units.rightText: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

units.leftText: In the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth day of the tenth month, a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and reported, “The city has been taken!”
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

units.leftText: Now the evening before the fugitive arrived, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer mute.
units.rightText: Now the hand of Jehovah had been upon me in the evening, before he that was escaped came; and he had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, those living in the ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’
units.rightText: Son of man, they that inhabit those waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.

units.leftText: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You eat meat with the blood in it, lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. Should you then possess the land?
units.rightText: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes unto your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

units.leftText: You have relied on your swords, you have committed detestable acts, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’
units.rightText: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbor’s wife: and shall ye possess the land?

units.leftText: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field I will give to be devoured by wild animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague.
units.rightText: Thus shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As I live, surely they that are in the waste places shall fall by the sword; and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured; and they that are in the strongholds and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

units.leftText: I will make the land a desolate waste, and the pride of her strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will become desolate, so that no one will pass through.
units.rightText: And I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment; and the pride of her power shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, so that none shall pass through.

units.leftText: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed.’
units.rightText: Then shall they know that I am Jehovah, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment, because of all their abominations which they have committed.

units.leftText: As for you, son of man, your people are talking about you near the city walls and in the doorways of their houses. One speaks to another, each saying to his brother, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD!’
units.rightText: And as for thee, son of man, the children of thy people talk of thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from Jehovah.

units.leftText: So My people come to you as usual, sit before you, and hear your words; but they do not put them into practice. Although they express love with their mouths, their hearts pursue dishonest gain.
units.rightText: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but do them not; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goeth after their gain.

units.leftText: Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.
units.rightText: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

units.leftText: So when it comes to pass— and surely it will come— then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
units.rightText: And when this cometh to pass (behold, it cometh), then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

units.leftText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?
units.rightText: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, even to the shepherds, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe unto the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the sheep?

units.leftText: You eat the fat, wear the wool, and butcher the fattened sheep, but you do not feed the flock.
units.rightText: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill the fatlings; but ye feed not the sheep.

units.leftText: You have not strengthened the weak, healed the sick, bound up the injured, brought back the strays, or searched for the lost. Instead, you have ruled them with violence and cruelty.
units.rightText: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought back that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with rigor have ye ruled over them.

units.leftText: They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts.
units.rightText: And they were scattered, because there was no shepherd; and they became food to all the beasts of the field, and were scattered.

units.leftText: My flock went astray on all the mountains and every high hill. They were scattered over the face of all the earth, with no one to search for them or seek them out.’
units.rightText: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my sheep were scattered upon all the face of the earth; and there was none that did search or seek after them.

units.leftText: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
units.rightText: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:

units.leftText: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because My flock lacks a shepherd and has become prey and food for every wild beast, and because My shepherds did not search for My flock but fed themselves instead,
units.rightText: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely forasmuch as my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the beasts of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my sheep;

units.leftText: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’
units.rightText: therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of Jehovah:

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand from them My flock and remove them from tending the flock, so that they can no longer feed themselves. For I will deliver My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.’ The Good Shepherd (Psalm 23:1–6|PSA 23:1-6*; John 10:1–21|JHN 10:1-21*)
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; and I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

units.leftText: As a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep when he is among the flock, so I will look for My flock.
units.rightText: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so will I seek out my sheep; and I will deliver them out of all places whither they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

units.leftText: I will bring them out from the peoples, gather them from the countries, and bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines, and in all the settlements of the land.
units.rightText: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

units.leftText: I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
units.rightText: I will feed them with good pasture; and upon the mountains of the height of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie down in a good fold; and on fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

units.leftText: I will tend My flock and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak; but the sleek and strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.’
units.rightText: I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but the fat and the strong I will destroy; I will feed them in justice.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.
units.rightText: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the he-goats.

units.leftText: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of the pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink the clear waters? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
units.rightText: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have fed upon the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? and to have drunk of the clear waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

units.leftText: Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’
units.rightText: And as for my sheep, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto them: Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

units.leftText: Since you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak ones with your horns until you have scattered them abroad,
units.rightText: Because ye thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

units.leftText: I will save My flock, and they will no longer be prey. I will judge between one sheep and another.
units.rightText: therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.

units.leftText: I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them. He will feed them and be their shepherd.
units.rightText: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

units.leftText: I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be a prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken. The Covenant of Peace
units.rightText: And I, Jehovah, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them; I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

units.leftText: I will make with them a covenant of peace and rid the land of wild animals, so that they may dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forest.
units.rightText: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

units.leftText: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season— showers of blessing.
units.rightText: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.

units.leftText: The trees of the field will give their fruit, and the land will yield its produce; My flock will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke and delivered them from the hands that enslaved them.
units.rightText: And the tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase, and they shall be secure in their land; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those that made bondmen of them.

units.leftText: They will no longer be prey for the nations, and the beasts of the earth will not consume them. They will dwell securely, and no one will frighten them.
units.rightText: And they shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the beasts of the earth devour them; but they shall dwell securely, and none shall make them afraid.

units.leftText: And I will raise up for them a garden of renown, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.
units.rightText: And I will raise up unto them a plantation for renown, and they shall be no more consumed with famine in the land, neither bear the shame of the nations any more.

units.leftText: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are My people,’ declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: And they shall know that I, Jehovah, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: ‘You are My flock, the sheep of My pasture, My people, and I am your God,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: And ye my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
units.rightText: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

units.leftText: and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Mount Seir. I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolate waste.
units.rightText: and say unto it, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against thee, and I will make thee a desolation and an astonishment.

units.leftText: I will turn your cities into ruins, and you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Because you harbored an ancient hatred and delivered the Israelites over to the sword in the time of their disaster at the final stage of their punishment,
units.rightText: Because thou hast had a perpetual enmity, and hast given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end;

units.leftText: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, it will pursue you.
units.rightText: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: since thou hast not hated blood, therefore blood shall pursue thee.

units.leftText: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and will cut off from it those who come and go.
units.rightText: Thus will I make mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation; and I will cut off from it him that passeth through and him that returneth.

units.leftText: I will fill its mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.
units.rightText: And I will fill its mountains with its slain: in thy hills and in thy valleys and in all thy watercourses shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

units.leftText: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will make thee a perpetual desolation, and thy cities shall not be inhabited; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Because you have said, ‘These two nations and countries will be ours, and we will possess them,’ even though the LORD was there,
units.rightText: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Jehovah was there:

units.leftText: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will treat you according to the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred against them, and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.
units.rightText: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast showed out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I shall judge thee.

units.leftText: Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard every contemptuous word you uttered against the mountains of Israel when you said, ‘They are desolate; they are given to us to devour!’
units.rightText: And thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, have heard all thy revilings which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour.

units.leftText: You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me. I heard it Myself!
units.rightText: And ye have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard it.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

units.leftText: As you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel became desolate, so will I do to you. You will become a desolation, O Mount Seir, and so will all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the LORD.[’’]
units.rightText: As thou didst rejoice over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say: O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou, son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of Jehovah.

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the enemy has said of you, ‘Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession,’
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha! and, The ancient high places are ours in possession;

units.leftText: therefore prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Because they have made you desolate and have trampled you on every side, so that you became a possession of the rest of the nations and were taken up in slander by the lips of their talkers,
units.rightText: therefore prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the nations, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;

units.leftText: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which are become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are round about;

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Surely in My burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, who took My land as their own possession with wholehearted joy and utter contempt, so that its pastureland became plunder.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land unto themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.

units.leftText: Therefore, prophesy concerning the land of Israel and tell the mountains and hills, the ravines and valleys, that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I have spoken in My burning zeal because you have endured the reproach of the nations.
units.rightText: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because ye have borne the shame of the nations:

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I have sworn with an uplifted hand that surely the nations around you will endure reproach of their own.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I have sworn, saying, Surely the nations that are round about you, they shall bear their shame.

units.leftText: But you, O mountains of Israel, will produce branches and bear fruit for My people Israel, for they will soon come home.
units.rightText: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

units.leftText: For behold, I am on your side; I will turn toward you, and you will be tilled and sown.
units.rightText: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown;

units.leftText: I will multiply the people upon you — the house of Israel in its entirety. The cities will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.
units.rightText: and I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded;

units.leftText: I will fill you with people and animals, and they will multiply and be fruitful. I will make you as inhabited as you once were, and I will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: and I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited after your former estate, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Yes, I will cause My people Israel to walk upon you; they will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will no longer deprive them of their children.
units.rightText: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of children.

units.leftText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because people say to you, ‘You devour men and deprive your nation of its children,’
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because they say unto you, Thou land art a devourer of men, and hast been a bereaver of thy nation;

units.leftText: therefore you will no longer devour men or deprive your nation of its children, declares the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nation any more, saith the Lord Jehovah;

units.leftText: I will no longer allow the taunts of the nations to be heard against you, and you will no longer endure the reproach of the peoples or cause your nation to stumble, declares the Lord GOD.” A New Heart and a New Spirit (Romans 8:9–11|ROM 8:9-11*; Galatians 5:16–26|GAL 5:16-26*)
units.rightText: neither will I let thee hear any more the shame of the nations, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nation to stumble any more, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, when the people of Israel lived in their land, they defiled it by their own ways and deeds. Their behavior before Me was like the uncleanness of a woman’s impurity.
units.rightText: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their doings: their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

units.leftText: So I poured out My wrath upon them because of the blood they had shed on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
units.rightText: Wherefore I poured out my wrath upon them for the blood which they had poured out upon the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols;

units.leftText: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered throughout the lands. I judged them according to their ways and deeds.
units.rightText: and I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

units.leftText: And wherever they went among the nations, they profaned My holy name, because it was said of them, ‘These are the people of the LORD, yet they had to leave His land.’
units.rightText: And when they came unto the nations, whither they went, they profaned my holy name; in that men said of them, These are the people of Jehovah, and are gone forth out of his land.

units.leftText: But I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations to which they had gone.
units.rightText: But I had regard for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations, whither they went.

units.leftText: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: It is not for your sake that I will act, O house of Israel, but for My holy name, which you profaned among the nations to which you went.
units.rightText: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I do not this for your sake, O house of Israel, but for my holy name, which ye have profaned among the nations, whither ye went.

units.leftText: I will show the holiness of My great name, which has been profaned among the nations— the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Lord GOD, when I show My holiness in you before their eyes.
units.rightText: And I will sanctify my great name, which hath been profaned among the nations, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the nations shall know that I am Jehovah, saith the Lord Jehovah, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

units.leftText: For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and I will bring you back into your own land.
units.rightText: For I will take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

units.leftText: I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols.
units.rightText: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

units.leftText: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
units.rightText: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

units.leftText: And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances.
units.rightText: And I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep mine ordinances, and do them.

units.leftText: Then you will live in the land that I gave your forefathers; you will be My people, and I will be your God.
units.rightText: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

units.leftText: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will summon the grain and make it plentiful, and I will not bring famine upon you.
units.rightText: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the grain, and will multiply it, and lay no famine upon you.

units.leftText: I will also make the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field plentiful, so that you will no longer bear reproach among the nations on account of famine.
units.rightText: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

units.leftText: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your iniquities and abominations.
